content.title: Craft Progression | Raw Material to Finished-Product Proof
content.summary: First, a single raw material is given, and then the hand operations with different functions and increasing difficulty are used to continuously change its shape; a clear heat treatment completes the irreversible folding, and then is quickly plated, and the finished product is used to prove the results of all previous actions.

quick_start.input_format: Single raw material + at least 3 deformation operations with different functions + 1 irreversible processing + finished product assembly + macro close-up final certification that retains traces of the previous process
quick_start.recommended_input: The solar sail restorer stretched, slits, woven and tensioned the same bundle of plant fibers into a hexagonal frame, and only hot-pressed it once to complete the sealing. Finally, macro verification was used to prove that the finished film still retains traces of stretching, weaving and sealing.
required_anchors: Establish one raw material and its maker before complex manipulation.
Use at least three functionally different manipulations that visibly change the same material.
Cross one visible irreversible processing threshold before the result assembly.
End on a macro finished-state proof that retains visible evidence of earlier transformations.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: First, a single raw material is given, and then the hand operations with different functions and increasing difficulty are used to continuously change its shape; a clear heat treatment completes the irreversible folding, and then is quickly plated, and the finished product is used to prove the results of all previous actions.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Turn craft into a visible proof ladder: establish one raw material, perform several functionally different manipulations that progressively change its length, topology or organization, cross one irreversible processing threshold, assemble the result, and end on a macro finished-state proof that visibly inherits features created earlier.

invariants.rule: Establish one raw material and its maker before complex manipulation.
invariants.purpose: Gives viewers a stable before state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening on spectacle removes the transformation baseline.

invariants.rule: Use at least three functionally different manipulations that visibly change the same material.
invariants.purpose: Makes skill cumulative rather than repetitive.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated tossing without distinct material effects is only flourish.

invariants.rule: Keep the material identity and work-surface geography continuous across the manipulation ladder.
invariants.purpose: Lets viewers connect each phase causally.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unmotivated material substitutions break the proof.

invariants.rule: Cross one visible irreversible processing threshold before the result assembly.
invariants.ablation_failure: A finished object appearing without a threshold feels swapped in.

invariants.rule: End on a macro finished-state proof that retains visible evidence of earlier transformations.
invariants.purpose: Closes the causal ladder with a verifiable result.
invariants.ablation_failure: A wide beauty shot alone hides whether the material work mattered.

slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source noodle dough and shrimp bowl
source noodle-loop choreography and food macro finish
